skill_name: Explain the critical points of the movie "Avengers Endgame".
workflow: "Avengers: Endgame" is the culmination of a 22-film arc, and was the final movie in the Infinity Saga. The plot follows the Avengers as they try to undo the damage caused by the Mad Titan Thanos, who wiped out half of all living beings. The movie contains several plot twists and turns, but the most important plot points focus on time travel, the consequences of the threat posed by Thanos, and the ultimate sacrifice of several beloved characters.
